memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease.
Evidence: ALT 68 U/L (ref 7-56), AST 45 U/L (ref 8-48), fasting triglycerides 210 mg/dL, HDL 38 mg/dL, LDL 130 mg/dL, platelet count 210 ×10^9/L. Abdominal ultrasound shows grade I hepatic steatosis, spleen normal.
Patient reports occasional mild right upper quadrant heaviness and fatigue; examination reveals BMI 27 kg/m2, no hepatomegaly, no palpable spleen. Smoking status: former, 20 pack-years, quit 2010.

Duration: 3 months

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I have been feeling a bit more tired lately, especially after long days at the flower shop. No new pain or jaundice.

memories.text:
Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease.
Evidence: ALT 48 U/L (7-56), AST 36 U/L (8-48), triglycerides 165 mg/dL, HDL 42 mg/dL, LDL 118 mg/dL, platelet count 215 ×10^9/L. Ultrasound shows unchanged grade I steatosis.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Liver Function Test: ALT 50 U/L (7-56), AST 38 U/L (8-48). Lipid Profile: Triglycerides 158 mg/dL, HDL 43 mg/dL, LDL 115 mg/dL. Platelet Count: 218 ×10^9/L.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow-up appointment booked with Dr Suresh Menon for 2025-10-05 at 10:30 AM.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Abdominal ultrasound: liver shows grade I-II hepatic steatosis, no focal lesions, portal vein normal, spleen size 11 cm.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Referral to Dr Priya Nair, Hepatology, Vikram Hospital, for further evaluation of NAFLD progression and possible fibrosis assessment.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Hepatology consult: FibroScan shows CAP 260 dB/m, EID 6.8 kPa (F1-F2). Recommend continue lifestyle, silymarin, and consider vitamin E. No pharmacologic therapy change advised.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease.
Evidence: ALT 78 U/L (7-56), AST 55 U/L (8-48), triglycerides 220 mg/dL, HDL 36 mg/dL, LDL 138 mg/dL, platelet count 202 ×10^9/L. Ultrasound shows grade II steatosis, mild splenomegaly 12 cm.
Patient reports mild right upper quadrant discomfort after meals and increased fatigue; exam: BMI 28 kg/m2, liver edge palpable 2 cm below costal margin, spleen palpable. Smoking status: former, 20 pack-years, quit 2010.
